data.gender_notes: Hajir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Hajir is an Arabic name that refers to one who migrates from a place of evil to a place of righteousness, following the example of Prophet Muhammad's migration from Mecca to Medina. The name Hajir carries the meaning “Migrator to the righteous path” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hajir usually hope their child will grow to embody migrator to the righteous path and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Hajir symbolizes leaving the darkness of ignorance for the light of faith.
data.etymology: Hajir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Migrator to the righteous path.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hajir total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: حاجر

in_urdu.name: حاجر
in_urdu.long_meaning: حاجر ایک مذکر نام ہے جو اسلامی ثقافت میں استعمال ہوتا ہے اور اس کا تعلق عربي جڑح ج ر سے ہے، جو محفوظ یا ممنوع کے معنی رکھتا ہے، اور اس کا تذکرہ قرآن مجید میں بھی ہے، جو اسلامی روایات میں اس نام کی اہمیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے

in_pashto.name: حاجر
in_pashto.long_meaning: حاجر د اسلامی فرهنگ کې یو نوم دی چې د عربي ریښ ح ج ر څخه اخیستل شوی، چې د ساتل شوی یا منع شوی په معنی دی، او د قرآن کریم کې یې هم ذکر شوی، چې د افغان او پښتنو دودونو کې د دې نوم اهمیت څرګندوي
